load_application: Each inferred bogie resultant is split equally between its two axles; each axle is split equally between left and right wheel/rail contacts. Each wheel carries one quarter of the bogie resultant. Wheel forces are distributed to deck-shell nodes through a configurable rectangular rail/ballast footprint using tributary-area weights. With conserve_wheel_resultant=true, each wheel resultant is preserved exactly while the axle centre is inside the original bearing-to-bearing moving-load interval.
nominal_state: Median accepted 2024 low-force 5 m/s^2 shaker fit for each of the two identified global modes.
ensemble_state: 84 weighted empirical modal states: 20 genuine same-run 2024 pairs plus 64 within-level 2025 marginal-product states. Campaigns receive equal total weight; excitation levels receive equal weight within campaign.
validation_policy: The 2025 shaker blocks are not falsely rank-paired. Their bending/torsion empirical marginals are combined within common excitation level as product states; campaign membership remains explicit.
old_arbitrary_perturbation_policy: Do not combine the previous independent EI/mass/coupling/end-restraint perturbation standard deviations with this ensemble unless explicitly studying a second uncertainty layer. That would double-count structural uncertainty.
table_5_2_policy: Lorenzen Table 5.2 belongs to the HUMVIB footbridge and is not imported into Garather Bach. Garather Bach uses the Section 7.2.3 top-flange subgrade reaction value 700000 kN/m^3.
sofi_cdb_status: The supplied sofi-service package is a generic SOFiSTiK CDB interface. It contains no Garather Bach .cdb/.dat. It is retained as a future extraction route if the original CDB becomes available.
load_transfer_parameter_status: Rail gauge 1.435 m is used for the explicit two-rail geometry. The longitudinal and transverse footprint dimensions are exposed modelling assumptions for sensitivity analysis and are not fitted to Bridge West target strain, displacement, or static weighing.
